name: Intelie
summary: Interactive React dashboards and Highcharts visualizations for real-time oil and gas operations analytics, built during my ViaSat engagement.
description: I contributed to Intelie's Performance Optimization work through interactive dashboards and data visualizations for real-time oil and gas operations. I integrated complex datasets into React interfaces using Highcharts, collaborated with backend teams on data accuracy and performance, and improved the usability and performance of data-heavy internal analytics tools.

pt-BR.description: Contribuí para a área de Performance Optimization da Intelie com dashboards interativos e visualizações de dados de operações de óleo e gás em tempo real. Integrei conjuntos de dados complexos em interfaces React com Highcharts, colaborei com equipes backend na precisão dos dados e no desempenho, e melhorei a usabilidade e o desempenho de ferramentas internas de análise intensivas em dados.
